personality_one_liner: A precise, clean iOS-native workforce attendance platform featuring secure Google authentication, real-time geofence verification, face liveness checks, and comprehensive admin controls.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS vertical rhythm with clean spacing, comfortable hit targets, and safe area padding at screen roots.

do's: Use frosted glass headers and bottom tab bars over scrolling content
Ensure solid tinted contrast backing for text over translucent elements
dont's: Never blur form inputs or body text regions
Do not stack more than 2 blurred layers per screen

screens.name: Auth / Google Login
screens.purpose: Secure Google Sign-In with credential verification and access request state.

states.loading: Centered red activity indicator with verification status message
states.empty: Clean sign-in card with Google branding and secure enterprise badge
states.error: Banner alert showing authentication failure with a retry button

screens.layout: Centered hero layout with PT PKUCity red & white branding, prominent Google sign-in button, and secure auth verification status indicator.

screens.name: Home / Attendance Check-In
screens.purpose: Primary check-in dashboard with real-time GPS geofence validation and face camera liveness capture.

states.loading: Skeleton card loader for today's shift status and location fix
states.empty: Prompt to enable GPS and camera permissions for attendance
states.error: GPS out-of-range or liveness check failed alert with troubleshooting guide

screens.layout: Top status card showing office distance & radius, live map preview placeholder, current shift schedule, and large sticky red primary check-in CTA.

screens.name: Attendance History
screens.purpose: View past attendance logs, check-in timestamps, geolocation coordinates, and verification status.

states.loading: Vertical skeleton list rows matching punch record items
states.empty: No attendance records illustration with prompt to clock in
states.error: Failed to load history message with retry action

screens.layout: Date-grouped list of punch records with status pills (Success, Rejected - Geofence, Rejected - Liveness), check-in times, and location coordinates.

screens.name: Admin Management
screens.purpose: Admin control center for managing work schedules, office geofence coordinates/radius, and admin role requests.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for admin stats and pending requests
states.empty: No pending access requests or schedule updates
states.error: Failed to sync admin settings with retry CTA

screens.layout: Segmented administrative dashboard with tabs for Pending Access Approvals, Office Geofence Settings (lat/long/radius), and Weekly Schedule configuration.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Employee profile, Google account info, admin access request submission, and app preferences.
screens.layout: Card-based profile view with Google avatar, verified email, role badge (Employee / Admin), Request Admin Access button, and sign out.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all screens adhere to the red and white PKUCity theme with clean iOS styling. Implement real-time geolocation geofence calculation against office coordinates, face liveness detection simulation via camera capture, Google Sign-In verification, and admin approval workflows. Keep touch targets >= 44x44pt and respect safe areas at all screen roots.
